instruction:
You are a civil pipe reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-15 pipe product certificate package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Pipe product certificate and hydraulic workflow routes shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-15-LH-05`
- Pipe datasheet: `PIPE-15-DATA-05`
- Pipe schedule: `PIPE-15-SCHED-05`
- Long section: `LONG-15-SECTION-05`
- Hydraulic criteria: `CRIT-15-HYD-05`
- Product certificate: `CERT-15-PIPE-05`
- Pipe product memo: `MEMO-15-PIPE-05`

All checks use the same pipe product, long-section grade, and use-case boundary. Do not change the product identity, pipe segment, grade, certificate, or criteria unless you explicitly flag a source conflict.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Design flow | {{ flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Internal diameter | {{ internal_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Pipe slope | {{ pipe_slope }} |
| Minimum slope | {{ minimum_slope }} |
| Manning n | {{ manning_n }} |
| Minimum velocity | {{ min_velocity_m_s }} m/s |
| Maximum velocity | {{ max_velocity_m_s }} m/s |
| Design pressure | {{ design_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Certificate pressure rating | {{ certificate_pressure_rating_kpa }} kPa |
| Design temperature | {{ design_temperature_c }} degC |
| Lining temperature rating | {{ lining_temperature_rating_c }} degC |

Velocity equals flow divided by pipe area. Manning capacity uses full-pipe area, hydraulic radius `diameter / 4`, the source slope, and the source roughness.

## Output Format

Write a compact pipe product memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "flow_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "velocity_low_margin_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "velocity_high_margin_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "manning_capacity_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "capacity_margin_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "slope_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "pressure_certificate_margin_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "lining_temperature_margin_c": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-15 pipe product certificate template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned pipe datasheet, long section, criteria, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "pipe-product-velocity-slope-certificate-package"
description = "SSC-15 pipe product velocity, slope, capacity, certificate, and lining checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound pipe product compliance metrics from a deterministic SSC-15 task-owned source pack. The template combines one pipe datasheet, pipe schedule, long section, hydraulic criteria sheet, certificate, and pipe product memo."
discipline = "civil"
category = "pipe-product-compliance"
standards = ["pipe velocity review", "gravity pipe slope review", "product certificate review"]
tags = ["civil", "pipe", "certificate", "velocity", "slope", "manning", "product-compliance", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "CRIT-15-HYD-05 design flow through the pipe"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.internal_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "PIPE-15-DATA-05 certified internal pipe diameter"
min = 200.0
max = 200.0

[params.pipe_slope]
type = "float"
description = "LONG-15-SECTION-05 pipe grade"
min = 0.008
max = 0.008

[params.minimum_slope]
type = "float"
description = "CRIT-15-HYD-05 minimum accepted pipe grade"
min = 0.006
max = 0.006

[params.manning_n]
type = "float"
description = "PIPE-15-DATA-05 pipe roughness value"
min = 0.013
max = 0.013

[params.min_velocity_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "CRIT-15-HYD-05 minimum velocity criterion"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.max_velocity_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "CRIT-15-HYD-05 maximum velocity criterion"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.design_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PIPE-15-SCHED-05 design pressure at the product use case"
min = 830.0
max = 830.0

[params.certificate_pressure_rating_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "CERT-15-PIPE-05 certificate pressure rating"
min = 1200.0
max = 1200.0

[params.design_temperature_c]
type = "float"
unit = "degC"
description = "PIPE-15-SCHED-05 design fluid temperature"
min = 45.0
max = 45.0

[params.lining_temperature_rating_c]
type = "float"
unit = "degC"
description = "CERT-15-PIPE-05 lining temperature rating"
min = 60.0
max = 60.0

[outputs.flow_velocity_m_s]
description = "Design flow divided by pipe area"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.velocity_low_margin_m_s]
description = "Flow velocity minus minimum velocity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.velocity_high_margin_m_s]
description = "Maximum velocity minus flow velocity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.manning_capacity_l_s]
description = "Full-pipe Manning capacity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.capacity_margin_l_s]
description = "Manning capacity minus design flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.slope_margin]
description = "Pipe slope minus minimum slope"
tolerance = 0.0003

[outputs.pressure_certificate_margin_kpa]
description = "Certificate pressure rating minus design pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.lining_temperature_margin_c]
description = "Lining temperature rating minus design temperature"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when velocity, capacity, slope, pressure, and lining checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc15_pipe_certificate_case]
description = "Pipe product velocity, slope, and certificate compliance case"
site_contexts = ["ssc15-pipe-certificate"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-15 pipe product compliance package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc15_pipe_certificate_case"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-15 pipe product compliance package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc15_pipe_certificate_case"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-15 pipe product compliance package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc15_pipe_certificate_case"]
